videos.title: Teleshopping
videos.description: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

videos.title: A Place in the Sun
videos.description: Jo and Neil are starting a new life in Lecce in southern Italy, and want a property that's close to the beach with a guest annexe. Jasmine Harman shows them what their £200k budget can buy.

videos.title: A Place in the Sun
videos.description: Laura Hamilton is on Portugal's Costa da Caparica helping Caron and Ivo hunt a holiday home that might become permanent. They have a budget of £300,000 to find a property with enough space for Ivo's five motorcycles and Caron's collection of clothes.

videos.title: A Place in the Sun
videos.description: Don and Margaret are looking for a holiday bolthole where they can escape the British winters on the spectacular coast of Portugal's western Algarve. Scarlette Douglas lines up five fantastic options for their £300,000 budget.

videos.title: Come Dine with Me
videos.description: The competition is in Hull and first to host is 29-year-old welfare team leader Jennie. Jennie is honouring Hull's fishing history with her under-the-sea theme and hopes to win the prize catch.

videos.title: Come Dine with Me
videos.description: It's the second night of this new competition in Hull, and the turn of 28-year-old wrestling promoter and novice cook, James to host. James is hoping to get his hands on the prize with a Mexican themed night that includes staging a full-blown wrestling match as his evening's entertainment.

videos.title: Come Dine with Me
videos.description: This week's competition is in Hull and third to host is 47-year-old wedding stationery entrepreneur, Katrena. Vegetarian Katrena loves nothing more than a bit of glitz and glamour, and she's hoping to wow her guests with a showy cruise ship themed night to bag the thousand pound prize.

videos.title: Come Dine with Me
videos.description: In Hull and fourth to host is 41-year-old super-confident mum of three, Natalie. Unimpressed by the food so far, Natalie reckons good quality produce can easily bag her the thousand pound prize. But can she win her guests over?

videos.title: Come Dine with Me
videos.description: It's the fifth and final night of the week's competition in Hull and retirement community manager George is hoping his menu of simple tasty favourites will win him the prize. Having heavily criticised the food on the past four nights, expectations about his menu are running high.

videos.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
videos.description: In the west of Scotland, Gavin and Johanna start things off with a loosely Italian-themed menu. Day two sees Sharyn and David's main course of beef stroganoff failing to live up to its billing. Finally, Daljit and Gordon get their turn to impress.

videos.title: Aldi: The Next Big Seller
videos.description: Possibly the world's first vegan egg, flavoured sauerkraut, a fruity fizzy drink with added fibre and a protein-packed cookie dough dessert inspired by an old Malaysian family recipe compete for a spot in Aldi's Healthy & Wholesome section.

videos.title: A Place in the Sun
videos.description: Danni Menzies house-hunts with Anne and Gordon from Northumberland, who met each other four years ago and now dream of buying a holiday home together in Kefalonia. With a budget of £200,000, Danni hopes to find them their perfect property.

videos.title: A Place in the Sun
videos.description: Carol and Russell look for a forever home in rural Coín in southern Spain. Jasmine Harman shows them five options for their maximum budget of £350k. A solar-powered stunner leaves them speechless, and a turnkey treat gives them food for thought.

videos.title: A Place in the Sun
videos.description: Father and son Sam and Dillon want a holiday home in the Abruzzo region of Italy. Lee Juggurnauth shows them what their maximum budget of £100k can get them, from a rustic apartment to a place with personality and a characterful courtyard.

videos.title: A Place in the Sun
videos.description: Jenny and keen golfer Emrys dream of owning a holiday home in Nerja on the Costa del Sol. Laura Hamilton shows them five fabulous options for their budget of £220k, including an in-demand apartment and a tempting traditional house.

videos.title: Location, Location, Location
videos.description: We catch up with Cara and Ben in Essex, who found their dream digs in 2016. And after a successful search in 2014, how are Sally and Steve getting on in their Warwickshire abode?

videos.title: Grand Designs
videos.description: Paul and Amy Wilkinson build a lakeside home in Lincolnshire with five circular timber buildings linked by walkways, but Paul's health suffers as he struggles to finish the build a year.

videos.title: Kevin McCloud's Classic Car Road Trips
videos.description: Kevin revels in some of the Peak District's heart-racing driving roads in a classic Jaguar Mk2, marvelling at the power of its straight six engine, and explores the history of its birthplace in Coventry.

videos.title: Sarah Millican: Control Enthusiast
videos.description: Sarah Millican returns to the stage with her show covering topics such as road rage, IBS, her favourite word and how she lets her husband know that "tonight's the night".

videos.title: Daddy's Home
videos.description: An insecure man competes for the affection of his stepchildren when their freewheeling father breezes back into town.

videos.title: The Dog House
videos.description: Seventeen-year-old farmer Sam seeks a tractor cab companion, preferably one that likes to dance. Can cocker spaniel Araf hit the right note? And can Woodgreen's most relaxed resident, Fia, help to soothe a family in need?

videos.title: First Dates
videos.description: Father and son duo Brian and Thomas visit the First Dates restaurant for a double date. A make-up influencer struggles to open up to his tall, dark and handsome date. And a disco dancing widower seeks more than just a dance partner as he turns 60.

videos.description: Jodie and Zoe are called to break up a brawl between neighbours, but while one neighbour protests his innocence, the CCTV says otherwise. A child who's been found wandering the streets late at night doesn't want to tell officer Emma who he is.

videos.title: Four in a Bed
videos.description: Karen and Adrian stake a claim for being the busiest B&Bers in 'Four in a Bed' history at The Barn in North Yorkshire. One guest reckons that such a big to-do list means the hosts haven't paid enough attention to his poached eggs at breakfast.
